teacher: Frozen same base model, reference solution visible, LoRA disabled

training.loss: FP32 all-position full-vocabulary forward KL; vocabulary-term upper clip .05
training.train_on: Original student rollout only; no token replacement or gap-based intervention
training.checkpoint_retention: Keep all checkpoints; no automatic deletion

gap.divergence: Unclipped full-vocabulary forward KL at temperature 1.1
gap.index: Zero-based RESPONSE TOKEN index: peak C=2; max starts C=2; pre starts B=1
gap.candidates: Response index >=1; all 10 target tokens and preceding token must be non-special
gap.max_pre_common_window: peak_response_index + K, H<=64, paired common valid length
gap.random_window: random_start + K, paired with original branch
gap.short_trajectory: Keep original trace, record fallback; do not drop the training example
gap.teacher_eos: Honor EOS, record actual K; no fabricated padding or continuation after EOS
gap.selection_rng: Private deterministic RNG, does not consume student rollout RNG

schedule: Original OPSD only; base validation once; train/save/validate every 5 updates; manual stop
stop: User stops manually using STOP file or SIGINT; finish current optimizer update and save

datasets.overlap_policy: Remove normalized exact AIME25 question matches; preserve order; no outcome/length filtering
